hardware.candidate_role: USB/display signer review-detail style cleanup smoke
hardware.tested_state: firmware rebuilt and flashed after removing the obsolete review detail label style from host-core, vector generation, and raster color mapping

procedure: Removed the obsolete ReviewBodyLineStyle::Label path from the ESP32 host-core review display enum, compact-style handling, T-Display S3 raster color mapping, and transport-vector generator.
Added a firmware-project regression test requiring the obsolete label style to stay out of active ESP32 review-detail code paths.
Ran nSealr/esp32 make ci with 48 Python tests, host-core tests, compileall, and firmware validation.
Exported ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell invocation used for build, flash, and smoke.

Verified idf.py resolved under /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/tools/idf.py, esptool.py resolved under /Users/vincenzo/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.9_env/bin/esptool.py, and idf.py --version reported ESP-IDF v5.5.4.
Built app version 5280fab with make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-build.
Flashed bootloader, app, and partition table to /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 with make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-flash and verified image hashes.
expected_result: The firmware still builds, flashes, and preserves the disabled signing protocol contract after removing the obsolete label review-detail style path.
observed_result: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 built app version 5280fab with binary size 0x8e650 and 0x719b0 bytes free in the app partition. esptool detected ESP32-S3 QFN56 revision v0.2 with native USB-Serial/JTAG and MAC ec:da:3b:95:32:98, wrote bootloader, app, and partition-table images, and verified hashes. The smoke passed with 35 verified exchanges: 8 valid response frames and 27 expected rejection frames. sign_event remained signing_disabled.
limitations: This run verifies build, flash, and protocol behavior after a review-detail style cleanup; it is not a new manual visual inspection.
The run does not visually prove every review-detail page style on the physical display; shared vector and host-core tests cover the data contract.
The protocol response for sign_event remains signing_disabled.
No persistent key custody, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, enclosure, or production approval policy was validated.
